job: Bring the current cruush v1 production line up to date in staged, reversible batches: rescue only still-relevant pending fixes, resolve compatible dependency security drift, verify production configuration, and reconcile GitHub issues, pull requests, CI, and operational documentation.
preserved: Current production behavior, approved assets, V1 visual design, privacy rules, location controls, moderation behavior, and user data remain unchanged except for fixes proven missing from current main.
Only current, independently verified changes are rescued from dirty or stale worktrees. No worktree or branch is merged wholesale.
V2 Liquid Glass, V2 crypto processor, Instagram marketing, recovery, and corrupt-migration work remain isolated from main and production.

Dependency updates are staged. Compatible security and patch updates may enter the V1 release; breaking major upgrades remain on a separate non-production branch until independently migrated and verified.

GitHub issues close only after focused and live proof. Pull requests close only after their change is confirmed present or intentionally superseded on main. Remote branches remain unless separately authorized for deletion.
No production secret value is printed, committed, or changed. Configuration mutations are limited to proven drift and require working authenticated access.
nonGoals: Do not merge, push, or deploy V2 Liquid Glass or V2 crypto work.
Do not delete dirty worktrees, unique commits, remote branches, user assets, or recovery snapshots.
Do not combine breaking dependency migrations with the compatible V1 security release.
Do not change providers, rotate secrets, enable paid services, alter billing, modify production data, or weaken privacy or moderation controls.
Do not close a GitHub issue or pull request based only on source similarity, a build, or a page load.
proof: Compare every candidate dirty change against current origin/main and rescue only behavior or tests that remain missing and in scope.
Run focused tests for each rescued fix, dependency audit, type and production builds, complete regression gate, product-name casing, public-copy, layout, JSON, diff, and conflict-marker checks.

Render and exercise every affected V1 UI route at real small-mobile and desktop viewports. For signup and map changes, include Android Chrome-sized viewports and top, middle, and bottom scroll positions with no overlap or clipping.
Verify current GitHub CI at the published V1 SHA, Coolify deployment completion, repeated frontend responses, direct API health, and exact API build metadata.
Record blocked production configuration checks if authenticated Coolify access cannot be restored without new credentials.
Confirm V2 worktree heads, dirty state, and paths remain unchanged after V1 publication.
publicationTarget: origin/main and V1 production after all required proof; V2 remains local-only and undeployed
